1.text: Haleluya.Muririmbire Uwiteka indirimbo nshya,Muririmbire ishimwe rye mu iteraniro ry'abakunzi be.

2.text: Ubwoko bw'Abisirayeli bunezererwe umuremyi wabwo,Abana b'i Siyoni bishimire Umwami wabo.

3.text: Bashimishe izina rye imbyino,Bamuririmbishirize ishimwe,Batambira ishako, batengerera inanga.

4.text: Kuko Uwiteka anezererwa abantu be,Azarimbishisha abanyamubabaro agakiza.

5.text: Abakunzi be bishimire icyubahiro abahaye,Baririmbishwe n'ibyishimo,Baririmbire ku mariri yabo.

6.text: Ishimwe ryo gusingiza Imana ribe mu mihogo yabo,N'inkota ibe mu ntoki zabo,

7.text: yo guhōrēsha amahanga,No guhanisha amoko ibihano

8.text: Bakabohesha abami bayo iminyururu,N'abanyacyubahiro bayo imihama,

9.text: Kugira ngo babasohozeho iteka ryanditswe,Icyo ni icyubahiro cy'abakunzi be bose.Haleluya.
